title: 第25章鼎纹归位
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
陈青山回到丁七号时，天已经擦黑。

    他没急着进屋，先在门口站了会儿，听隔壁的动静。周小满那边翻了个身，又传来啃干饼的咔嚓声，听着挺香；再远些，院外有人骂骂咧咧，说今日功德殿排队排到腿软。没人盯着这边。

    他这才推门进去，反手插栓，扯了块旧布把窗缝塞严，回头往炉子里添了两块湿炭。烟味慢慢冒出来，呛得人嗓子发痒，他自己先咳了两声。

    不错。别人闻见，只会当他又在折腾破铜胚。

    桌上很快摆开一摊东西：破铜胚、旧抄页、飞刀胚、火脉洞临时牌，还有一小包炉灰。摆这些是给人看的，真正要用的，在石柜夹层里。

    陈青山蹲下身，抽开最外面那块烂木板，从灰布底下摸出一个小铁盒。盒上缠着三道旧布，布上抹过炉灰和回气丹末，味儿乱七八糟，闻着就让人不想多碰。他拆到最后一层，手不自觉慢了下来。

    盒里躺着两枚黑沉沉的金属片。

    一枚来自旧矿道石室，一枚来自那个灰布面具。两枚上头都刻着半个残缺的“玄”字，笔画不全，可每回靠近，识海里的造化鼎都要动一动。

    他盯着看了半晌，没急着上手。

    这玩意儿邪性。头一回在石室里，他差点被那股牵引勾得直接往鼎里塞；后来清点灰布面具的战利品，鼎又动过一次，他也是硬忍住的。不是不想要，是怕一口吃撑，把自己撑死——金手指再好，也不是祖宗喂饭，它要灵力，要材料，到头来还要命。

    先试小的。

    陈青山从袖里摸出那枚七寸飞刀胚。刀尖钝，刀背裂，杀鸡都嫌不利索，拿来撬盒刮料倒是顺手。他把第一枚玄片压在旧木板上，用刀尖沿着边角一点点刮，刮了十几下，才掉下一小撮黑粉，比炉灰还细。

    就这点。先喂灰。

    他把玄片放回盒里，只捏起那撮黑粉，闭上眼。

    识海里，造化鼎静静悬着，锈迹仍厚，炉盖上那两个“炼宝”字比从前清楚了些。修补区在鼎腹一侧，像被人硬挖出来的一道小槽，旁边还有一条细细的浅槽，形状细长，真像少了一支刻刀。

    陈青山没把黑粉直接丢进去，先用一缕灵力裹住它，停在鼎口外头。一息，两息……没炸，也没把他神识往里拖。他又等了十息，才把那撮黑粉轻轻送进鼎中。

    嗡。

    鼎身低低一震。不是上回吞灵器碎片那种猛震，也不是修补残卷时的细光。这一次，鼎壁上那层厚锈像被火燎了一下，慢慢浮起一条暗金色的细线，只亮了一瞬就灭了。

    陈青山睁眼，先摸了摸鼻子——没流血；再探丹田，灵力少了约莫半成，不多。

    安全。至少这点黑粉安全。

    他又等了一盏茶，确认没有后劲，才从盒里取出第一枚玄片。

    玄片入手冰凉。屋里明明烧着炭，指腹却像贴上了井底的石头。他把它搁在掌心，没召鼎，只让识海里的造化鼎自个儿去感应。

    鼎没动。

    他把第二枚也取了出来。两枚玄片刚一靠近，掌心忽地一沉——不是重量变了，是那两个残缺的“玄”字对上了半笔。一枚缺上，一枚缺下，拼不成整字，却刚好接出一截弯钩。弯钩一成，识海里的造化鼎猛地转了一下。

    陈青山手指一紧，立刻把两枚分开。鼎也跟着停了。

    他看着桌面，半天没出声。

    懂了。这东西不是喂进去才管用，它本来就跟鼎是一路货色，光是靠近，也能补。

    这就好办多了。能不吃就不吃，能白嫖一点是一点。

    陈青山把门栓又压实一遍，连床底都扫了一眼，这才坐回桌边，垫了两张废纸在掌下，把两枚玄片慢慢往一处推。

    一寸。半寸。指宽。

    识海里的造化鼎开始发烫。鼎壁上第一条暗金旧纹亮起，跟着是第二条、第三条——那些旧纹平日都藏在锈底下看不见，此刻却一点点浮出来，绕着鼎腹转了半圈。陈青山咬住牙，丹田里的灵力被抽走一成。还撑得住。

    两枚玄片又近了半分。

    嗡——

    这一下，陈青山眼前猛地一黑。

    他看见一片烧焦的土地。不是器峰后坡那种零星焦木桩，而是整片地都裂了开来，沟壑里淌着红光；天上有东西砸落下来，砸进山腹，石头被掀得翻起，火浪朝四面滚去。
content_en:
When Chen Qingshan returned to Ding No. 7, it was already dark.

    He didn't rush into the house, but stood at the door for a while, listening to the noise next door. Zhou Xiaoman turned over, and there was the sound of chewing dry biscuits again, which sounded very fragrant; further away, someone outside the hospital was cursing, saying that the queue at the Gongde Hall today was so long that his legs were weak. No one is watching here.

    He then pushed the door open, bolted the bolt with his backhand, pulled an old piece of cloth to seal the crack in the window, and then went back and added two pieces of wet charcoal to the stove. The smell of smoke slowly came out, making his throat itchy. He coughed twice first.

    good. When others hear this, they will just think that he is tossing out copper embryos again.

    A pile of things was quickly placed on the table: broken copper embryos, old copy pages, flying knife embryos, temporary Fire Vein Cave cards, and a small bag of furnace ashes. These are for people to see, the ones that are really needed are in the mezzanine of the stone cabinet.

    Chen Qingshan squatted down, pulled away the rotten wooden board on the outside, and took out a small iron box from under the gray cloth. There are three old cloths wrapped around the box. The cloth has been smeared with furnace ashes and rejuvenating elixir. It smells messy and makes people not want to touch it anymore. He removed the last layer and his hands unconsciously slowed down.

    There were two dark metal pieces lying in the box.

    One came from the old mine stone chamber, and the other came from the gray cloth mask. Both of them are engraved with half of the incomplete character "Xuan", and the strokes are incomplete, but every time they come closer, the fortune cauldron in the sea of ​​consciousness will move.

    He stared at it for a long time, not in a hurry to get started.

    This thing is evil. The first time he was in the stone room, he was almost tempted by the pulling force and pushed directly into the cauldron. Later, when he was counting the trophies of the gray cloth mask, the cauldron moved again, but he also resisted. It's not that I don't want it, but I'm afraid that one bite will overwhelm me to death - no matter how good Golden Finger is, it's not like being fed by ancestors. It requires spiritual power, materials, and in the end, life.

    Try the small one first.

    Chen Qingshan took out the seven-inch flying knife embryo from his sleeve. The tip of the knife is blunt and the back of the knife is cracked. It is not easy to kill chickens, but it is easy to use to pry boxes and scrape materials. He pressed the first mysterious piece on the old wooden board and scraped it along the edge with the tip of the knife. After scraping it for more than ten times, a small amount of black powder fell off, which was finer than furnace ashes.

    That's it. Feed the ash first.

    He put the mysterious tablet back into the box, picked up only the pinch of black powder, and closed his eyes.

    In the sea of ​​​​consciousness, the cauldron of creation hangs quietly, the rust is still thick, and the two words "Lianbao" on the furnace lid are clearer than before. The repair area is on the side of the belly of the tripod, like a small groove dug out by someone, and there is a thin shallow groove next to it. The shape is long and slender, and it really looks like a carving knife is missing.

    Chen Qingshan did not throw the black powder directly into it, but first wrapped it with a ray of spiritual power and stopped it outside the mouth of the tripod. One breath, two breaths... It didn't explode, nor did it drag his consciousness inside. He waited another ten breaths before gently sending the pinch of black powder into the cauldron.

    Buzz.

    The tripod trembled lowly. It wasn't the violent shock like when the fragments of the spiritual weapon were swallowed last time, nor was it the thin light when repairing the broken scroll. This time, the thick layer of rust on the cauldron wall seemed to have been burned by fire, and a dark golden thin line slowly emerged, which only lit up for a moment and then disappeared.

    Chen Qingshan opened his eyes and touched his nose first - there was no bleeding; then he checked his Dantian and found that his spiritual power was reduced by about half, not much.

    Safety. At least this is safe for black fans.

    He waited for another cup of tea to confirm that there was no stamina, and then took out the first mysterious piece from the box.

    Mysterious pieces come in cold. The room was clearly burning with charcoal, but the fingertips felt like stones stuck to the bottom of a well. He placed it in the palm of his hand and did not summon the cauldron. He only let the cauldron of creation in the sea of ​​consciousness sense it on its own.

    The tripod did not move.

    He took out the second one as well. As soon as the two mysterious tablets came closer, the palm of my hand suddenly sank - it wasn't that the weight had changed, it was because the two incomplete characters "Xuan" were halfway aligned. One is missing, and the other is missing. The whole word cannot be spelled out, but a curved hook just comes out. As soon as the hook was formed, the cauldron of creation in the sea of ​​consciousness turned violently.

    Chen Qingshan tightened his fingers and immediately separated the two pieces. Ding also stopped.

    He looked at the table and said nothing for a long time.

    Got it. This thing doesn't work just by feeding it in. It's the same thing as the tripod. Just being close to it can make it useful.

    This is much easier to handle. If you can't eat it, don't eat it. If you can, just do it for free.

    Chen Qingshan tightened the door bolt again, even glanced under the bed, then sat back at the table, placed two pieces of waste paper under his palm, and slowly pushed the two mysterious tablets together.

    One inch. Half an inch. Refers to width.

    The cauldron of creation in the sea of ​​consciousness began to get hot. The first old dark gold pattern on the cauldron wall lit up, followed by the second and third lines - those old patterns were usually hidden under the rust and invisible, but now they emerged little by little and circled half a circle around the belly of the cauldron. Chen Qingshan gritted his teeth, and 10% of the spiritual energy in his dantian was drained away. Still holding up.

    The two mysterious pieces were half a minute closer.

    Buzz——

    At this moment, Chen Qingshan's eyes suddenly darkened.

    He saw a charred land. It wasn't the scattered charred wooden piles on the back slope of Qi Peak, but the whole land was cracked open, and red light flowed in the ravines; something fell from the sky and smashed into the belly of the mountain, rocks were lifted up, and waves of fire rolled in all directions.
title_en: Chapter 25 The tripod pattern returns to its place
